properties.name: text
properties.comment: The edited text (Text); a view onto the editing engine. A write ends any completion and composition, starts a new history, scrolls to the start and raises text_changed, then selection_changed. A multiline box refuses invalid UTF-8, more than 1 MiB or a line over 4096 bytes (std::invalid_argument). maximum_length does not truncate a written value.
hand: a view onto the editing engine; write_view keeps set_text's refusal, reset and event order (text_changed, then selection_changed)

properties.name: placeholder_text
properties.comment: The hint shown in the empty field. Without one, the field's tooltip (Control::field_hint_text) shows there in the same light grey while the field has focus. Throws std::invalid_argument for invalid UTF-8.

table.description: The hint the box shows while it is empty.

prepare: if (!validate_utf8(incoming).valid()) throw std::invalid_argument("TextBox placeholder must be valid UTF-8");

properties.name: read_only
properties.comment: Whether the user may select and copy the text but not change it (ReadOnly); a view onto the editing engine. A change ends any completion.

table.description: Whether the user may select and copy the text but not change it.

hand: a view onto the editing engine

properties.name: multiline
properties.comment: Opt-in plain-text document editing (Multiline). Stored line endings are preserved; Enter inserts newline_sequence, and Tab is separately opt-in (accepts_tab). Turning it on throws std::invalid_argument for a password box or a text multiline editing refuses.

table.description: Whether the box holds several lines, wrapping and scrolling vertically.

hand: prepare checks the current text and password masking; written reconfigures the engine and resets the scroll

properties.name: word_wrap
properties.comment: Whether a multiline box wraps its lines at the box's width (WordWrap); a wrapped document overflows only vertically.
hand: written drops the wrap width and the sideways scroll

properties.name: newline_sequence
properties.comment: What Enter inserts in a multiline box: LF (the default), CR or CRLF; anything else throws std::invalid_argument.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("TextBox newline must be LF, CR, or CRLF");

properties.name: accepts_tab
properties.comment: Whether Tab inserts a tab in a multiline box (AcceptsTab) instead of moving the focus.

properties.name: accepts_enter
properties.comment: In a single-line box Enter is the box's own only while it has something to accept: an open suggestion list or appended completion, or an input-method composition; otherwise Enter goes on to the containers and the window's accept button. A box that is an edit session (a search field, an in-place editor) opts in with accepts_enter: plain Enter with nothing else to accept then raises committed() and stops there. Off by default. A multi-line box always takes Enter to insert newline_sequence.

properties.name: accepts_escape
properties.comment: Escape is the box's own only while it has something to cancel: an open suggestion list or appended completion, an input-method composition or a selection drag; otherwise Escape goes on to the containers, menus and the window's cancel button. A box that is an edit session opts in with accepts_escape: plain Escape with nothing else to cancel then raises cancelled() and stops there. Off by default.

properties.name: maximum_length
properties.comment: The most Unicode scalars a user edit, a paste or a semantic set-value may leave (MaxLength); zero admits any text that fits the store. A write does not truncate the text. A view onto the editing engine; more than 16 Mi throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto the editing engine

properties.name: password_character
properties.comment: The character shown for each character of the text (PasswordChar); U'\0' for none. Throws std::invalid_argument in a multiline box or for anything but one printable Unicode scalar.
hand: written ends any completion and drops the layout and the sideways scroll

properties.name: use_system_password_character
properties.comment: Whether the text is masked with the system's password character (UseSystemPasswordChar). Throws std::invalid_argument when turned on in a multiline box.
hand: written ends any completion and drops the layout and the sideways scroll

properties.name: font
hand: shared FontCapability<TextBox>; written drops the layout

properties.name: auto_complete_mode
properties.comment: How completions are offered (AutoCompleteMode): none, suggest (a list under the box), append (the rest of the first match, selected) or both. Auto-complete acts only in a single-line, unmasked, writable box with no edit filter; otherwise the settings are kept and do nothing. Matching is by prefix, ignoring ASCII case unless auto_complete_case_sensitive.
hand: written ends any completion; defined in text_box_auto_complete.cpp

properties.name: auto_complete_source
properties.comment: Where completion candidates come from (AutoCompleteSource). list_items throws std::invalid_argument: a TextBox has no list (an editable ComboBox offers its items through its own setting).
hand: prepare refuses list_items; written ends any completion; defined in text_box_auto_complete.cpp

properties.name: auto_complete_custom_source
properties.comment: The candidates for AutoCompleteSource::custom_source (AutoCompleteCustomSource). Never null: a new box owns an empty collection. Assigning one shares it (see AutoCompleteStringCollection); null throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare refuses null; written ends any completion; defined in text_box_auto_complete.cpp

properties.name: auto_complete_case_sensitive
properties.comment: Whether completion matches ASCII case exactly; off by default.
hand: written ends any completion; defined in text_box_auto_complete.cpp

properties.name: text_alignment
properties.comment: Where a single-line box's text sits when it is narrower than the box (TextAlign): near, center or far; a multiline box keeps its text at the near edge.
prepare: if (incoming > HorizontalAlignment::far) throw std::invalid_argument("TextBox text alignment is unknown");

not_properties.name: auto_scroll
not_properties.reason: ScrollableControl's cell; TextBox reacts through on_auto_scroll_changed

not_properties.name: selection / select
not_properties.reason: two offsets written together, clamped to grapheme boundaries

not_properties.name: set_edit_filter
not_properties.reason: a delegate for composites, not a value

not_properties.name: set_auto_complete_anchor
not_properties.reason: an observed control, not a value
